chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fazala ibn Ayyub, from Abu al-Maghra', from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever wants to live my life, and die my death, and enter the Garden of Eden which God, my Lord, planted with His own hand — let him take Ali ibn Abi Talib as his guardian, let him befriend his friend, and let him be inimical to his enemy, and let him submit to the successors after him. For indeed they are my progeny, from my flesh and blood; God gave them my understanding and my knowledge. I complain to God about the matter of my community — those who deny their merits, those who sever my connection to them. And I swear by God, they will surely kill my son. God shall not grant them my intercession!'

key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: Legatees/successors — the Imams appointed by the Prophet
key_terms.جَنَّةَ عَدْنٍ: The Garden of Eden — the highest level of Paradise
key_terms.شَفَاعَتِي: The Prophet's intercession on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.عِتْرَتِي: My progeny/family — the Ahlulbayt, especially the Imams
key_terms.فَلْيَتَوَلَّ: Wilaya — guardianship, devotion, and allegiance to the Imams

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about following Imam Ali and the successors to enter Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith is a powerful prophetic declaration transmitted by Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) through a chain leading back to Aban ibn Taghlib. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) specifies that anyone who desires to emulate his way of life and death, and gain entry into the Garden of Eden, must take Ali ibn Abi Talib as their guardian, befriend his allies, oppose his enemies, and submit to the Imams after him. The Prophet identifies the Imams as his flesh and blood, divinely endowed with his own understanding and knowledge. He concludes with a lament — complaining to God about those in his community who deny the Imams' virtues and sever his spiritual bond with them, and foretells that they will kill his grandson (Imam Husayn), warning that they shall be deprived of his intercession on the Day of Judgment.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Abu Al Magra’a, from Muhammad Bin Salim, from Aban Bin Taghlub who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who wants that he should live (like) my<sup>saww</sup> life, and he should be dying (like) my<sup>saww</sup> death, and enter the Garden of Eden which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> my<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Planted with His<sup>azwj</sup> Own Hands, so let him befriend Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin AbuTalib<sup>asws</sup>, and let him befriend his<sup>asws</sup> friends, and let him be inimical to his<sup>asws</sup> enemies, and let him submit to the successors<sup>asws</sup> (who would come) after him<sup>asws</sup>, for they<sup>asws</sup> are my<sup>saww</sup> family, from my<sup>sa</sup><sup>ww</sup> flesh and my<sup>saww</sup> blood. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Gave them my<sup>saww</sup> understanding and my<sup>saww</sup> knowledge. 
I<sup>saww</sup> complain to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> of the matter of my<sup>saww</sup> community, the deniers of their<sup>asws</sup> merits, the cutters of my<sup>saww</sup> relationship in them. And I<sup>saww</sup> swear by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, they would be murdering my<sup>saww</sup> (grand) son<sup>asws</sup>. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not let them attain my<sup>saww</sup> intercession!’’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ’Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fudala ibn Ayyub from abu a1-Maghra from Muhammad ibn Salim from Aban ibn Taghlib from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Whoever would want to live like my living, die like I will die and enter the garden of Eden that my Lord has planted with His own hands, he must love (acknowledge the Divine authority of) Ali (a.s.) ibn abu Talib. He must love (acknowledge the Divine authority of his successor) those who love him, be the enemy of his enemies and submit in obedience to his successors after him because they are of my family and my flesh and blood. Allah has given them my understanding and knowledge. I appeal to Allah and complain to Him about the case of my people’s dealings, their denying the virtue and excellence of the Imams from my family. I complain to Allah for their disregard of my relation with them. By Allah, they will murder my son (al-Husayn (a.s.). May Allah deprive them of my intercession.’”
